verdict.rationale: The pack includes an item sourced from a GitHub repository (github.com/BerriAI/litellm), but no item states what license the source is under or that it is open source. The only license mention is an enterprise 'one license' line, which points to commercial licensing, not an open license. Without documented open-license terms, the openness story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
